plain_english_thesis: Steady Tide trades large-cap US stock momentum only when the market regime is supportive.
mandate_disclosure_paragraph: Steady Tide is a tactical partial stock strategy. It may deploy only a small share of the stock sleeve while idle paper cash remains parked.
drawdown_headline: Bench max drawdown was 8.9%; future paper or live results may be worse.
paper_live_distinction: This Guided v1 slice runs in paper mode only; no real money moves.
not_guaranteed_copy: Past performance does not guarantee future results, and paper fills may differ from live fills.
what_you_accept_bullets: Steady Tide can buy and sell US equities in your paper account.
Idle paper cash may park in short-term Treasury ETFs.
Each strategy position uses a 5% stop loss, 15% target, and max-hold exit.
You can pause or stop the paper enrollment at any time.
required_attestation_text: I understand this is paper trading, the strategy can lose money, and past performance is not a guarantee.
